description: (0.5.0) Producer scope of the RFC-ACDP-0014 §7 trigger: a verified revocation changes a context's verdict only when it speaks for that context's producer (producer-signed: same body.agent_id; registry-attested: metadata.revoked_key_controller equals the context's agent_id, with §6 scoping). Closes the §13 cross-producer case for consumers that hold revocations outside per-producer discovery (out-of-band, fingerprint-keyed caches, caller-supplied sets). REQUIRED for 0.5.0 consumers.

input.key: K, a key of producer B; contexts below are signed by K and receipt-attested after T

scenarios.name: A — cross-producer revocation held out of band

expected.behavior: DID A publishes a §5-valid revocation naming K's fingerprint. The consumer holds it out of band. A K-signed, post-T context from B is unaffected; the consumer MAY report the revocation as a hint.

scenarios.name: B — the same revocation published by B

expected.behavior: The same statement signed by B's current key applies: the post-T context fails closed.
